gate: npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run && npm run build && npm run probe:tools
servicesNote: Landing deploys the wrapper (dist/ + package files to /opt/linear-mcp, restart linear-mcp). The systemd unit and Caddyfile in deploy/ are still shipped by hand (deploy/README.md); a merge touching them runs `bin/deploy.sh --check-infra`, which fails the land until the box matches. bin/deploy.sh reads its target from LINEAR_MCP_DEPLOY_HOST in .envrc.
